payload.report: CT shows an orbital abscess from rhinosinusitis; biopsy shows fibropurulent inflammation without fungus; cultures grow coagulase-negative Staphylococcus and Enterococcus faecalis. Negative fungal cultures exclude fungal infection. These findings, with the clinical presentation, support bacterial sinusitis complicated by orbital abscess; malignancy and orbital inflammatory syndrome are unlikely. Thus the frontier is sufficiently refined: orbital abscess from bacterial sinusitis.
